aboutGame.title: What is enfosi?
paragraphs: enfosi is a co-op wave defense game on Roblox from the Tumore group. You and your team hold the line and keep a statue standing while waves of glaggles advance on it, earning gold between rounds to spend on weapons, items, and upgrades.

Every run escalates: slow clears let waves stack up, bosses arrive with new mechanics, and classes such as Cheerer, Risio, and Gleeber change how your team holds the line. Higher difficulty modes like Maniac push builds and coordination to the limit.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about enfosi.

items.question: What is enfosi?
items.answer: enfosi is a co-op wave defense game on Roblox from the Tumore group. You and your team defend a statue from waves of glaggles, earn gold between rounds, and spend it on weapons, items, and upgrades.

items.question: Which enfosi class should beginners pick?
items.answer: Start with a forgiving frontline class while you learn wave timing and boss patterns, then branch into support or damage once you know the maps.

items.question: How hard is enfosi maniac mode?
items.answer: Maniac mode is the toughest ruleset in enfosi. Enemies overlap their attacks, hazards trigger faster, and healing is reduced, so positioning and cooldown timing matter more than raw damage.

items.question: Does enfosi have active codes?
items.answer: enfosi does not currently have working redeem codes. This wiki tracks code status and lists new rewards as soon as they are confirmed.

items.question: How do I make money in enfosi?
items.answer: Clear waves efficiently, sell or salvage drops you do not need, and reinvest early in upgrades that raise your clear speed instead of saving for one expensive late-game item.
